title: Generations of Computers
htmlContent:
<h2>Generations of Computers</h2>
Five generations: 1st Vacuum Tubes (1940–1956), 2nd Transistors (1956–1963), 3rd Integrated Circuits (1964–1971), 4th Microprocessors (1971–Present), 5th Artificial Intelligence (Present & Beyond). Key examples include ENIAC, UNIVAC I, IBM 701, IBM 1401, IBM 360, IBM PC, Apple Macintosh, IBM Watson and modern AI assistants.
